# HydePHP

> HydePHP is a Laravel-powered static site generator for PHP. Build websites, blogs, and documentation using Markdown and Blade.

## Current documentation

- Documentation: https://hydephp.com/docs/2.x/
- Quickstart: https://hydephp.com/docs/2.x/quickstart
- Upgrade guide: https://hydephp.com/docs/2.x/upgrade-guide
- Changelog: https://hydephp.com/changelog

## Source and packages

- GitHub: https://github.com/hydephp/hyde
- Packagist: https://packagist.org/packages/hyde/hyde

## Versioning

HydePHP 2.x is the current stable documentation. Documentation under /docs/1.x/ is legacy and should not be used for new projects.
